## Arabic RTL & Localization

- [ ] CHK001 All user-facing strings are Arabic (no English leakage in labels, errors, toasts)
- [ ] CHK002 Layout uses `EdgeInsetsDirectional` / `AlignmentDirectional` (not `EdgeInsets` / `Alignment`)
- [ ] CHK003 Verified visually in RTL on a real device or emulator

## UI & Theme

- [ ] CHK004 Cairo font applied to custom text styles
- [ ] CHK005 Works in both light and dark mode (no hard-coded colors outside theme tokens)
- [ ] CHK006 Sizes use `flutter_screenutil` (`.w`, `.h`, `.sp`, `.r`) — no raw `double`

## Observability

- [ ] CHK007 Critical events logged via `AnalyticsService`
- [ ] CHK008 Network / parse errors reported via `FirebaseCrashlytics.recordError`
- [ ] CHK009 No `print` / `debugPrint` leftover in shipped code
